title: Starter document
summary: A sample that shows the offline research mode.
background: Assumption: the agent could not browse, so this background is written from the context only and has no citation.
process:
flowchart TD
  start([Request received]) --> review[Review the request]
  review --> complete{Is the context complete?}
  complete -->|Yes| draft[Draft the document]
  complete -->|No| ask[Ask for the missing context]
  ask --> review
  draft --> finish([Document returned])
